hookups.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/ryerson-station-state-park/stay ('Full-hookup campsites have: On-site water, 50-amp electric, Sewage hookup'; 'Electric-only sites are available with 50-amp hook ups') + ReserveAmerica catalog for parkId 880214 (6 Full-Hookup and 12 Modern Electric sites, all 50-amp), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Polly Hill Campground: DCNR counts a 35-site tent and trailer campground; on the booking site 18 take RVs (6 Full-Hookup, 12 Modern Electric) and 14 are Modern Tent Only, besides camping cottages. RV sites take 35-50 ft; two electric sites are pull-throughs.

sites.source: ReserveAmerica site list and details for parkId 880214 (type, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + DCNR stay page ('A 35-site tent and trailer campground'), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/ryerson-station-state-park/stay ('Modern restrooms with showers are available year round ... There is a sanitary dump station and coin-operated laundry facilities'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Full-hookup, modern electric and tent sites can be booked for the same day and up to 11 months ahead (ReserveAmerica booking window).

booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/ryerson-station-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880214 ('Full-Hookup ... Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance', same for Modern Electric), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed the inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window and the year-round season (already manual; RA 'Open year round'). Added 50-amp with water+sewer at 6 full-hookup sites, 18 RV sites to 50 ft with 2 pull-throughs (14 more are tent-only), showers/flush toilets/dump/laundry. Not stated: min/max stay, cutoff, walk-up. Fees left at the statewide table.
